common:generalComment.#text: Polypropylene (PP) is a widely used, recyclable thermoplastic polymer. It is the most commonly used plastic packaging material in the United States due to its melting point and strength. However, PP products degrade slowly in landfills, taking up to 20-30 years to degrade completely. It is used in a range of applications and products, from food packaging to automotive parts, and is known for its strength, durability, and resistance to chemicals and moisture.
聚丙烯（PP）是一种广泛使用的可回收热塑性聚合物。由于其熔点和强度，它是美国最常用的塑料包装材料。然而，聚丙烯产品在垃圾填埋场中降解缓慢，需要 20-30 年才能完全降解。从食品包装到汽车零件，聚丙烯被广泛用于各种应用和产品中，并以其强度、耐用性、耐化学性和耐湿性而著称。

common:generalComment.#text: Phosphating is a conversion coating applied to steel or iron components, mostly used as a pretreatment method for corrosion protection. The process involves immersing a component in a dilute solution, converting the surface of the metal into a layer of microscopic phosphate crystals. A layer of phosphate coating typically includes iron, zinc or manganese crystals. Phosphating is a surface preparation method for ferrous metals before coating or painting. It increases corrosion prevention and also helps improve anti-friction properties.
磷化是一种应用于钢或铁部件的转化涂层，主要用作防腐保护的预处理方法。该过程涉及将部件浸入稀溶液中，将金属表面转化为一层微观磷酸盐晶体。磷酸盐涂层通常包括铁、锌或锰晶体。磷化是铁质金属涂层或涂漆前的表面准备方法。它增加了防腐能力，也有助于提高抗摩擦性能。

common:generalComment.#text: Powder coating is a type of coating that is applied as a free-flowing, dry powder. It is typically applied electrostatically and then cured under heat or with ultraviolet light. It is a multi-step surface finishing process suitable for metal and non-metal substrates. The method includes a preparation, application, and curing stage. Powder coating is a mixture of polymer resin, flow modifiers, leveling agents, and other additives. After it has been heated and cured, powder coating produces tough finishes able to withstand extreme weather conditions while resisting fading and cracking.
粉末涂料是一种以自由流动的干粉形式施加的涂料。它通常通过静电方式施加，然后在热量或紫外线下固化。这是一种适用于金属和非金属基材的多步骤表面处理过程。该方法包括准备、应用和固化阶段。粉末涂料是聚合物树脂、流动改性剂、流平剂和其他添加剂的混合物。经过加热和固化后，粉末涂料能产生能够抵抗极端天气条件的坚韧表面，同时抵抗褪色和开裂。

common:generalComment.#text: Foamed plastic is a synthetic resin converted into a spongelike mass with a closed-cell or open-cell structure, which may be flexible or rigid. It is used for a variety of products including cushioning materials, air filters, furniture, toys, thermal insulation, sponges, plastic boats, panels for buildings, and even lightweight beams. Foamed plastics take all kinds of resin as the raw material and are heated until foams appear. They are a new type with the properties of lightweight, heat preservation, sound absorption, and quakeproof.
发泡塑料是一种合成树脂，转化为具有闭孔或开孔结构的海绵状质地，可能是柔软或硬质的。它被用于各种产品，包括缓冲材料、空气过滤器、家具、玩具、热绝缘材料、海绵、塑料船、建筑面板，甚至轻质梁。发泡塑料以各种树脂为原料，加热至出现泡沫。它们是一种新型材料，具有轻质、保温、吸音和抗震的特性。

common:generalComment.#text: Particle board, also known as chipboard or low-density fiberboard, is an engineered wood product manufactured from wood chips and a synthetic resin or other suitable binder. It is often confused with oriented strand board. It is a waste wood product made by binding wood chips, sawdust, or sawmill shavings with a synthetic resin or some other binder. Urea Formaldehyde is commonly used as a glue for binding wooden chips. It is a building material that is manufactured from lumber scraps such as wood shavings, wood chips, sawdust, and other by-products from lumber mill operations.
颗粒板，也被称为刨花板或低密度纤维板，是一种由木片和合成树脂或其他适当的粘合剂制成的工程木材产品。它经常被误认为是定向刨花板。它是一种由木片、锯末或锯木厂削片与合成树脂或其他粘合剂结合制成的废弃木材产品。尿素甲醛常被用作粘合木片的胶水。它是一种由木屑、木片、锯末和其他伐木厂副产品制成的建筑材料。

Hot melt adhesive is a plastic adhesive that changes its physical state with temperature within a certain temperature range, while its chemical properties remain unchanged. It is non-toxic and odorless, and is an environmentally friendly chemical product. Due to its solid nature, the product is easy to package, transport, store, solvent-free, pollution-free, and non-toxic; And it is highly favored due to its simple production process, high added value, high bonding strength, and fast speed.
热熔胶是一种可塑性的粘合剂，在一定温度范围内其物理状态随温度改变而改变，而化学特性不变，其无毒无味，属环保型化学产品。因其产品本身系固体，便于包装、运输、存储、无溶剂、无污染、无毒型；以及生产工艺简单，高附加值，黏合强度大、速度快等优点而备受青睐。
